QUOTE: Engine → caller, `char*` return or `char**` out-param | Caller owns it and must call `entropic_free()`. ... Engine → caller, `const char*` / static | Do not free. | `entropic_version` returns a static string.
VERDICT: MISS
WHY: The answer states the char* ownership/entropic_free rule but says only "do not free" for const char* and never says it is handle-owned and valid only until the next call on that handle.
